---
applyTo: "**/*.md"
---

Keep one canonical page per concept or feature under `wiki/`. Preserve provenance and traceability. Do not fabricate facts or silently resolve contradictions. Templates use `{{PLACEHOLDER}}`; real feature artifacts replace required placeholders or mark `TBD` with an owner and gate. Update section indexes, `wiki/index.md`, and `wiki/log.md` when durable knowledge changes.
